transitVisaType: Visa-Free Airside / $50 Instant eVisa with US/Schengen/UK
rulesSummary: Airside transit within the international transit area is 100% visa-free on connecting single tickets. If stepping out of the airport or doing a self-transfer, Indian citizens with a valid US, UK, or Schengen visa get an instantaneous online eVisa for $50.
criticalWarnings: Flying on to Mexico, Panama, Colombia or Venezuela? Indians need a free Electronic Airport Transit Visa (e-ATV) from evisa.gov.tr — even when staying airside.
Switching between Istanbul Airport (IST) and Sabiha Gökçen (SAW) requires a Turkish visa.
Self-transfers between separate tickets with checked bags require passing border control — you need a Turkish visa.
Turkish eVisa is conditional for Indians: you must hold a valid US, UK, Schengen or Ireland visa/residence permit.
Do not book separate tickets with under 3.5 hours between flights at IST.
stepByStepGuide: Deplane at IST and follow purple "International Transfers" signs if staying airside.
Clear security checkpoint with your onward boarding pass and proceed to departure gate.
If you have a 6+ hour layover during daytime, head to the Hotel Desk at Arrivals to register for free Touristanbul.
If layover exceeds 20 hours on single ticket, collect free hotel voucher from Turkish Airlines Hotel Desk.

research.summary: Turkish embassy notice: e-ATV required for Indians transiting IST to Mexico, Panama, Colombia and Venezuela (free, since 15 Apr 2024).

sources.label: Embassy of Türkiye, New Delhi — e-ATV announcement
Outlook Traveller — e-transit visa for Istanbul layovers

rulesSummary: The premier connecting hub for Indian travelers heading to South America (Brazil, Argentina) and Africa. No transit visa required for Indian citizens for layovers under 12 hours. Ethiopian Airlines provides free hotel rooms + free meals for transits between 8 and 24 hours.
criticalWarnings: Terminal 2 can get busy during nighttime wave hours; keep your boarding pass and passport handy.
Yellow fever vaccination card is not needed for airside transit, but recommended if visiting the city.
stepByStepGuide: Upon landing, proceed to the Ethiopian Airlines Interline Transfer Desk in Terminal 2.
Present your onward boarding pass to receive transit gate assignment.
If your connection is between 8 and 24 hours, the desk will issue a hotel voucher and an Ethiopian transit pass.
Take the designated complimentary hotel shuttle to Skylight Hotel or partner property.

transitVisaType: 48h Transit Visa (Free/Nominal) / 14-day VoA with US Visa
rulesSummary: Zero transit visa needed for stays under 24 hours in the transit area on a single ticket. For longer stays, Emirates sponsors a 48-hour transit visa (~₹1,200). Indian passport holders with valid US visas get 14-day VoA right at immigration.
criticalWarnings: Budget airline transfers between Terminal 2 (Flydubai/low cost) and Terminal 3 (Emirates) require an airside shuttle bus — allow at least 2.5 hours.
Self-transfers without baggage interline agreements require clearing immigration.
stepByStepGuide: Follow "Flight Connections" signs in Terminal 1, 2, or 3.
Clear security scanner.
Relax in terminal 24/7 duty-free shopping, sleeping pods, or lounges.
If holding US visa and wishing to exit, head directly to Marhaba / immigration counter for 14-day VoA stamp.

transitVisaType: Free 96-hour Transit Visa / Visa on Arrival
airlineProgramName: Discover Qatar Transit Tours & Stopover Packages
rulesSummary: Airside transit is 100% free without visa for up to 24 hours. Free 96-hour transit visa available when flying Qatar Airways. Stopover packages at 4-star hotels start at just $14/night through Discover Qatar.
criticalWarnings: If exiting the airport for a multi-day stay under Qatar VoA, mandatory hotel booking through Discover Qatar is required.
stepByStepGuide: Disembark and follow signs to Transfer Hub A, B, C, D, or E.
Visit Discover Qatar transit desk near the iconic giant Lamp Bear for discounted city excursions.
Board connection flight with minimal hassle in single mega-terminal.

rulesSummary: Malaysia grants 100% VISA-FREE entry to all Indian passport holders for up to 30 days! Self-transfers, terminal transfers between KLIA1 and KLIA2, or city day-trips require zero visa fees.
criticalWarnings: Complete the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC) within 3 days before arrival — also for self-transfers.
Carry proof of onward ticket, hotel and funds: KLIA has been refusing entry to Indians who can’t show them.
AirAsia flies from KLIA Terminal 2 — check both flights’ terminals.
stepByStepGuide: Fill out MDAC online before departure.
Upon arrival at KLIA, use standard foreign passport lanes or automated e-gates if eligible.
Collect baggage, change terminals, or take the 28-minute train into downtown Kuala Lumpur.

research.summary: Malaysia visa-free entry for Indians runs to 31 Dec 2026; MDAC mandatory; entry refusals reported at KLIA.

sources.label: Gulf News — Indians denied entry under Malaysia visa-free scheme

transitVisaType: Visa-Free Airside / 96-hour VFTF with US/UK/Schengen/Japan Visa
airlineProgramName: Free Singapore Tour (FST) by Changi & SIA
rulesSummary: Airside transit within Changi Terminals 1, 2, 3, and 4 is completely visa-free on through tickets. Under the Visa-Free Transit Facility (VFTF), Indian citizens holding a valid visa for US, UK, Schengen, Japan, Canada, Australia, NZ, or Germany can enter Singapore for up to 96 hours 100% VISA-FREE!
criticalWarnings: Self-transfer across low-cost carriers (like Scoot without Scoot-Thru) requires clearing immigration — you must qualify for VFTF or hold an entry visa.
Terminal 4 is not connected by airside Skytrain; requires airside shuttle bus.
stepByStepGuide: Arrive in Changi and enjoy free Jewel attractions and sky-trains in transit.
If you have a 5.5 to 24 hour layover, register at the Free Singapore Tour booths in T2 or T3.
If qualifying for VFTF, clear immigration with your qualifying onward ticket and secondary visa proof.

transitVisaType: Direct Airside Transit Visa (DATV) Required UNLESS Exempted
rulesSummary: CRITICAL TRAP FOR INDIANS: Indian nationals strictly require a Direct Airside Transit Visa (DATV) to transit London Heathrow, UNLESS they hold a valid visa or residence permit for the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, or Schengen Area!
criticalWarnings: NEVER transit London on an Indian passport without a valid US/Canada/Australia visa or an approved UK Transit Visa, or you will be denied boarding at origin in India!
E-visas for the US/Canada do not always exempt; physical visa foil or verified permit required.
stepByStepGuide: Verify DATV exemption status on the official UK government visa checker before booking any flight via London.
Ensure your connection departs on the same day or before 23:59 from the same airport.

transitVisaType: No airport transit visa needed (since 3 June 2026)
rulesSummary: Since 3 June 2026 Indian passport holders no longer need an airport transit visa at Frankfurt (also Munich, Berlin; Düsseldorf and Hamburg with limits) — provided you stay airside and fly on to a non-Schengen destination. Collecting bags, changing airports or leaving the airport needs a Schengen visa.
criticalWarnings: Airside only: separate tickets with checked bags require a Schengen visa.
Your onward flight must leave the Schengen area (e.g. to the US, Canada or UK).
stepByStepGuide: Only book German transit routes if you hold a valid physical visa for the US, UK, Canada, or Schengen.
Stay within the non-Schengen international transit area at Terminal 1 or 2.

research.summary: German airport transit visa requirement for Indians removed from 3 June 2026 (German Federal Foreign Office).

sources.label: The Local Germany — visa-free transit for Indian travellers
Wego — Indian nationals no longer need German ATV

transitVisaType: Free airside transit; UAE visa needed to leave the airport
rulesSummary: Single-ticket connections stay airside with no visa. Separate tickets mean collecting bags and re-checking, which needs a UAE visa (eVisa, or visa on arrival with a valid US/UK/EU visa or residence).
criticalWarnings: Low-cost carriers here do not interline — a delay on leg 1 means a missed leg 2 with no protection.
Allow 4+ hours for a self-transfer with checked bags.
stepByStepGuide: Follow "Transfers" signs if on one ticket.
For separate tickets: clear immigration with your UAE visa, collect bags, re-check at Departures.

transitVisaType: Visa-free entry for Indians (30 days from 15 Sept 2026)
rulesSummary: Indians can enter Thailand visa-free, so a landside self-transfer is easy. Fill in the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) online within 3 days of arrival.
criticalWarnings: Bangkok has two airports — AirAsia flies from Don Mueang (DMK), 1+ hour from BKK. Check both legs use the same airport.
TDAC is mandatory for every arrival, including self-transfers.
stepByStepGuide: Submit TDAC online before landing.
Clear immigration, collect bags and re-check at the Departures hall.
For DMK connections allow 5+ hours.

research.summary: Thailand visa exemption for Indians is 30 days from 15 Sept 2026; TDAC required.

transitVisaType: Free online ETA for Indians (since 25 May 2026)
rulesSummary: Single-terminal airport. For separate tickets, get the free online ETA and clear immigration to re-check bags.
criticalWarnings: Apply for the ETA on the official site only — agent sites charge fees.
stepByStepGuide: Apply for the Sri Lanka ETA online.
Clear immigration, collect bags, re-check at Departures.

research.summary: Sri Lanka free ETA for Indians from 25 May 2026.

transitVisaType: Free airside transit; Oman eVisa to leave the airport
rulesSummary: Airside transit is free on one ticket. Separate tickets need an Oman eVisa (Indians holding a valid US/UK/Schengen visa get easier entry).
criticalWarnings: SalamAir fares are cabin-bag only — add bags when booking.
stepByStepGuide: Apply for the Oman eVisa online if self-transferring.
Clear immigration, collect bags, re-check at Departures.

rulesSummary: Transfer facilities for separate tickets are limited — plan to enter Vietnam on an eVisa, collect bags and re-check.
criticalWarnings: VietJet base fares include only 7kg cabin baggage.
Apply for the eVisa at least a week ahead.
stepByStepGuide: Apply for the Vietnam eVisa on the official portal.
Clear immigration, collect bags, re-check at the international terminal.

rulesSummary: Airside transit on one ticket is fine. Self-transfers need the Kenya Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA).
criticalWarnings: eTA processing can take up to 3 working days.
stepByStepGuide: Apply for the eTA online.
Clear immigration, collect bags, re-check at Departures.
